notes.title: Cursed Armor is now updated to the uncensored version!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all our dedicated players for your love and support of [i]Cursed Armor[/i]. 

We are thrilled to announce that [i]Cursed Armor[/i] has now been updated to the "uncensored" and "latest" version. This allows players who may have had concerns in the past to rediscover the joy of [i]Cursed Armor[/i] and help us spread the word to new players.

In addition, we have some exciting news to share. We have confirmed a collaboration with the developer, wolfzq, to release [i]Cursed Armor 2[/i] on Steam. However, this project is still in the early stages, so we kindly ask for your patience as we work on it. We will share further updates with everyone as soon as we have more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33284155/5fc8bf1957160606400947ce73ec84fcdfb56137.png[/img]


For now, please enjoy the latest version of [i]Cursed Armor! [/i]

[h2] About game [/h2]

1500 years after the Demon King's seal

An innocent girl, Lilina, who dreams of being the best adventurer in the world, starts her journey.

Unfortunately, because of her bloodline, she has been chosen by a demon. She is forced to wear a set of cursed armor and goes on an adventure to find six divine artifacts to remove the curse...

[h2] Game Features [/h2]

All costumes affect the character’s avatar and pixel animations, with the Beauty Salon's cosplay system, you can customize the heroine to your own style.
All kinds of sexual events have been planted into multiple side-quests, we have over 200 events and 1134 CG variations in the game!
Scenarios matter! We make full use of the combinations of pixel animations and CGs to create perfect RPG game experiences.
Various paths, endings, and game rounds interact with each other, you will have at least 20+ hours of enjoyment of the game!
